annotations.text:
Lab-journal direction, built out from sketch B.
Warm paper ground, Newsreader serif for headline and body, IBM Plex Sans for labels, IBM Plex Mono for numbers. Two accents at matched chroma: rust for the published reference and ARIA run-in labels, teal for our measurements and KEEP.
Left column: one journal entry per experiment, newest first, ARIA's observation, hypothesis, configuration, measurement, decision and next question as prose. Right column: margin numbers, a chrome-free trajectory, the five test seeds, footnotes carrying the caveats, dataset note.
All text and numbers come from the real wf-20260913-live1 session.
The two original direction sketches, kept for reference. B was chosen.
